nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Deep Collagen Retinol Power Boosting Pad

avis.texte: These boosting pads are amazing!!! I am a 56 year young lady with some creases in my forehead and these pads help them to look less noticeable...have tried many products over the years and these really do work!!! And yes, it is temporary, but it does last all day!!! And the price is really good also!!! I would recommend these!!!

avis.titre: Glow and Get Smoother Skin with these padsGlow and Get Smoother Skin with these pads
avis.texte: I personally recommend using these at night followed by a good moisterizer for best results. It helps with my dull, tired skin. It also contains collagen which gives a glow and smoother skin appearance. Get these pads!!!!

avis.titre: These earned a permanent spot on my counterThese earned a permanent spot on my counter
avis.texte: I love these. I use one at night after I cleanse and my skin feels soft right away, not tight and not sticky. The pads come soaked, so I get plenty of product without squeezing anything out. My dry patches calmed down after a couple of weeks. The jar holds 100, so one lasts me a long time for what I paid. I already ordered a second.
The formula is great, the pads are just kind of small and they just roll up underneath my fingers

I have to say that these Sungboon Editor toner pads are pretty great. They contain a powerhouse of very good effective ingredients including Cica, Collagen, Allantion, Hyuralonic Acid, Adenosine and Retinol. I have used many toner pads before but never one containing Retinol so I had no idea what to expect from this product. Well it is nothing short of outstanding. These toner pads left my face so bright and toned with no dry tight sensation at all, but rather hydrating and moisturizing to my dry sensitive skin. The pads themselves are rather large and one was more than enough for my face and neck. They are extremely saturated with essence and you get 100 pads so this will last quite awhile. The pads are not solid but look more netted in appearance. They are not the softest I have used but that is a minor qualm They come well packaged with little tongs and expiration date. Retinol is listed fairly far down the line of the ingredients list so if you are concerned about a high percentage of Retinol it's not to strong and the Retinol is 500 ppb so it is relatively mild and caused no redness or irritations for me. That being said I have been using Retinol creams and serums on and off for many years. This is one of the better products I have tried but I won't use it every day, twice a week would be sufficient for me. An easy 5 stars and I definitely recommend this one

I am IMPRESSED!! These deep collagen retinol pads are amazing! They are meant to be used as a toner on the skin and boy does my skin love them! I have been using them 3 times a week for the last month and my skin is glowing! Just follow the directions and you have no problems. I am also pleased with the quantity of the product as they make sure to fill the container all the way to the top. This is a very good product. I have since looked at others to purchase from this brand. The only issue that I had was that it was EXTREMELY difficult to get the top of this container off and because of that I had to resort to poking through the seal to get to the pads.

These pads are great, especially for my deep wrinkles in my forehead. I have combination skin and it works great, had no reactions or issues, plus after wiping my face with it i would leave the pad on my deepest wrinkle areas for about few minutes so it will continue to soak up all the goodness! Definitely great addition to my skincare routine. But on the side note since these have retinol I would always use sunscreen just as regular part or morning skincare routine!

These pads are effective and you get 100! They easily adhere to the skin when patting down. You can leave on the area and let the essence absorb to treat the skin. They performed their magic and left my skin soft and supple. My skin did not react to the essence. They did a good job and they are a great value for the amount you get. I RECOMMEND.

This container is 6.42 fluid oz. It contains 100 soaked pads. Box as easy to read and follow instructions including how to use, cautions, and ingredients. Expiration date is clearly labeled on the bottom of the box and on the container itself. These are part of a beauty regiment and feel very nice on your face. Pads formula leaves your skin feeling clean and moisturized. Bonus was pads come with a small pair of dispensing tongs to help keep them sanitary.

The Sungboon Editor Deep Collagen Retinol Power Boosting Pad comes in a nice square container. There are 100 well soaked pads in it. I have dry sensitive skin and the pads feel cool and comfortable. I especially like the hydrating effect.

I am really loving all things Korean skincare. These patches are so easy to use. You simply use the tweezers to pull out, stretch and apply to your skin. It’s a great way to apply skincare and make you skin glow. I love the patches and the packaging of this product and I’ll definitely get again.
